Proposal planners, Oak Creek has a mirror for you. At Crescent Moon Picnic Site, Cathedral Rock reflects in the creek, and through November the gate stays open until 6 p.m., so a late-afternoon visit lands right in golden hour. We love it as the finale of a private tasting day: Verde Valley vineyards after lunch with your own guide and driver, then the creek before sunset. Leashed dogs are welcome

Couples chasing one perfect October evening: start with a private tasting beside a quiet vineyard pond, and end at a creekside table at Cress on Oak Creek. Cress sits right on the banks of Oak Creek at L'Auberge de Sedona, with dinner nightly from 5 PM and the Cress Bar open from 2 PM, so a slow wine-country afternoon can roll straight into a glass by the water.
